memory_candidates.content: A source-store deploy verification (deploy-headless.sh / verify-deploy.sh) confirms a source-store edit reached .claude/ ONLY for extensions actually loaded in the target repo's .claude-extensions.json. Before claiming a 'deploy-tree diff' acceptance check as satisfied for an extension-scoped file, first check whether that extension is loaded in the current repo -- an edit to an unloaded extension's files has no deployed counterpart at all, which is a stronger condition than the templated/merged-transform risk that diff mismatches are usually attributed to.

When multiple agent contracts each record a boolean verdict (e.g. build_passed) with no stated determination method, the vacuum invites an improvised, unreliable check (e.g. a process-count pgrep) at the first site an agent under pressure reaches. The durable fix is a single canonical evidence-hierarchy anchor (ordered weakest-to-strongest) that every determination site points at by heading reference, never restated -- this keeps N sites in sync from one edit and makes 'how is this verdict obtained' a answerable-by-grep question.
